skeleton.proportions: Each adult size has its own baked bind dimensions. Human and Dwarf share adult ratios; Halfgrown has short legs and large hands/feet.
skeleton.retargetCertification: Only the four delivered clips on each delivered bind rig are verified; no general retarget guarantee.

Rescue_Cheer.description: Raise one unarmed hand, wave, settle, and take one restrained joining step. Blend to Walk or Idle.

Duck_Crouch.description: Fully crouched small-step gait, with genuine hip/knee/spine deformation and planted stance feet. Blend into/out of crouch outside the roof edge.

capsules.radiusNote: Conservative horizontal circle around the actual measured AABB. Use the documented X/Z center offset; bounds include hands/helmet. These are authored suggested controller dimensions, not a game collision integration.

cageExit.recipe: Keep actor scale1. Place Ground at cage floorY0.305. Human uses Duck_Crouch with its documented controller speed until capsule clears the roof. Halfgrown/Dwarf fit standing. Controller collision/gravity transfers the0.305m floor step to world ground; no StepDown/terrain-IK clip is claimed. Never rescale the character invisibly.

checks: QA-reimport.json: actual final GLB import, all clip keytimes, four-weight vertices, native-vs-runtime comparison and24 phases each of Walk/Crouch.
